profile.ja: 対魔忍。『石遁の対魔忍』と呼ばれている。石遁の術の使い手で、武器として棍棒を用いながら、敵に無数の石をぶつけたり、石を集めてゴーレムを作ったり、石を纏い防具にしたりと石を様々な形で活用して戦う。サバサバした性格で、荒々しく猪突猛進なところがある。あるとき任務中に行方不明になり、仲間たちの捜索でも発見できずにいたが、突然ふらりと五車に戻ってきた。敵に捕らわれていたのか記憶がおぼつかない状態になっており、桐生達が様々な検査を行ったが、身体には何も異常は見つからなかった。アサギ達は彼女の様子を見つつ疑似訓練や記憶の回復を行い、現在では再び現場で対魔忍として活躍している。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin, known as the "Taimanin of Stone Concealment." She utilizes the art of stone concealment, using a club as her weapon while employing various tactics such as hurling numerous stones at her enemies, creating a golem by gathering stones, or using stones as armor. She has a straightforward and somewhat rough personality, with a tendency to charge in recklessly. At one point, she went missing during a mission and couldn't be found despite her comrades' search efforts, only to suddenly return to Gosha. She had no memory of being captured by the enemy, and although Kiryuu and the others conducted various examinations, no abnormalities were found in her body. Igawa Asagi and the others have been keeping an eye on her while providing pseudo-training and helping her recover her memories, and she is now once again active as a Taimanin on the front lines.

text.ja: 今日から配属された天野レナだ、よろしく。噂は聞いているかもしれないが……それを払拭できるよう、貢献させてもらおう
text.en: I'm Amano Lena, assigned to your team starting today. I've heard the rumors, but I'm going to prove them wrong and make a contribution.

text.ja: 噂の話を、聞いたんじゃないか？　確かにな……いきなりいなくなって、いきなり帰ってきたのでは、怪しまれても仕方ないと思っている
text.en: You've probably heard the rumors, haven't you? To be honest, I can understand why you'd be suspicious - I did disappear suddenly and then come back just as suddenly.

text.ja: 私自身も、いなくなっていたときの記憶がないからな……もし、なにか不穏な動きがあったら……どうか私を、止めてほしい
text.en: The thing is, I don't have any memories of the time I was missing... If something fishy happened during that time... please, stop me if you notice anything.

text.ja: 行方不明になっていた記憶はなくとも、自分の力のことくらいは覚えている。武器はこの棍棒、使う術は――石遁だ
text.en: Even though I don't remember being missing, I still recall my abilities. My weapon is this club, and the art I use is... Stone Concealment.

text.ja: 石遁なんて地味だと思っていないか？　どこにでもある石は、使いやすくて便利なんだぞ？　投げてよし、纏ってよし、固めればゴーレムにもなる
text.en: You don't think Stone Concealment is boring, do you? Stones are everywhere, and they're easy to use, convenient... you can throw them, wrap them around you, or even create a golem by solidifying them.

text.ja: 魔術で作られるものとは違うが、石遁のゴーレムは作りやすく、それでいて強度も高い。つなぎ目という弱点はあるが、サイズでカバーできるしな
text.en: Unlike those created with magic, my Stone Concealment golems are easy to make and have high strength. They do have a weak point where they're joined, but that can be covered up by their size.

text.ja: ふぅっ……お疲れ。いい訓練になったな……さて、汗を流そう。残念ながら、シャワールームは別だけどな
text.en: Whew... good workout. That was some great training... now, let's get cleaned up. Unfortunately, the shower room is separate, though.

text.ja: 次の任務は――ああ、あそこの繁華街か。ホテルや風俗も多いが、なにより治安が悪い。注意していこう
text.en: The next mission is... ah, that crowded downtown area. There are a lot of hotels and adult entertainment venues, but the crime rate is really bad. Let's be careful.

text.ja: どうした？　ああ、訓練のあとで、汗がすごいからか……ふふっ、私は気にしないぞ？　隊長の匂いなら……汗の匂いも、精液の匂いも……♪
text.en: What's wrong? Ah, after training, I'm just sweating a lot, that's all... heh, I don't mind, though. It's the Captain's scent... whether it's sweat or cum... I love it.

text.ja: ……ホテルに行こう。こんな近くで隊長の匂いを嗅がされると、我慢できない……チンポが欲しくて、たまらなくなるんだ……んっ……
text.en: Let's go to a hotel. If I'm this close to the Captain's scent, I won't be able to hold back... my pussy's aching, and I desperately need a cock...
